messages:
alex.m: Heads up — I hit a terraform plan hang in staging while applying the auth-service update. It hangs during provider selection and prints a multiple-provider-match error. Anyone seen this before?

sam: @alex.m can you paste the exact error output? :eyes:

alex.m: Here's the tail of the error I see in CI:
```
Error: multiple provider configurations match this resource; either specify a provider explicitly, or re-run with -reconfigure

  on modules/auth/main.tf line 72, in resource aws_ssm_parameter.auth_secret:
 72: resource aws_ssm_parameter.auth_secret {
```

maria: that usually happens when we have two provider aliases for aws (default + us-west) and a resource ended up in state without a clear provider mapping. Did you recently split regions or rework provider aliases?

alex.m: We added alias aws.us-west for west region a week ago and then did an import for an SSM param — I think the import landed but maybe without the provider meta.

lee: can you share output of `terraform providers` and `terraform state show module.auth.aws_ssm_parameter.auth_secret`? That'll tell us which provider the state thinks it belongs to.

alex.m: providers output shows the required provider is registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws ~> 4.0. State show says provider = provider[registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws.us-west] and name = /staging/auth/secret.

maria: state having the us-west provider is good, but the plan error implies Terraform finds more than one matching provider config for that resource address at plan time. Could be module/provider inheritance or a changed provider alias name.

sam: quick unblock ideas: add an explicit provider assignment to the resource in a local override (provider = aws.us-west) so plan chooses it unambiguously. Alternatively, run `terraform state replace-provider` if the provider plugin ref actually changed.

lee: I agree with the override approach to get unblocked. Add it in a non-committed override or a workspace-specific tfvars so you can revert after. Avoid heavy state surgery during peak hours.

alex.m: I'll try the override now in staging-only tfvars and re-run plan. Will report back in a minute.

infra-bot: deploy-bot noticed long-running plan in workspace staging-auth (duration 00:08:23) :robot_face:

alex.m: Quick follow-up — adding provider = aws.us-west in a staging override made the plan continue. Plan finished with no diffs. Apply should be safe. Thanks!

maria: nice. Follow-up ticket idea: normalize imported resources with `terraform state replace-provider` in a maintenance window so future imports don't leave ambiguous provider metadata. I'll open a short task and tag infra owners.

sam: +1, add me as a reviewer.

lee: optional: add a short test to our import playbook reminding to include provider alias mapping. That avoids accidental ambiguous imports.

alex.m: agreed. Closing this thread — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
